purpose: minimum deterministic offline reconstruction of one CONTROL interaction run and its canonical storage dependencies
required_content: all File records and raw objects referenced directly by the run or events
all File records and raw objects required by the exported Collection snapshot lineage
Collection descriptor and immutable snapshot lineage from the run-bound snapshot to revision 0 when a Collection is bound
excluded_by_default: current source Collection HEAD when it differs from the exact run-bound snapshot

reconstruction.reconstructed_head: exact run-bound Collection snapshot, not the source store's later HEAD
